learning_outcomes.text: Student is able to design simple subsystems of manipulators
Student has a knowledge about subsystems utilized in robotics and understands their composition and design.
Student is able to program simple control units of robots and understands the design of the programs used in controlling manipulators.
Student has the knowledge of chosen manipulators design

syllabus_topics: Introduction to robotics, construction of robots and manipulators
Denavit-Hartenberg notation, direct and inverse kinematics
Programming the movement paths of an industrial manipulators
assessment_rules: The passing threshold for the written report is 56.0%.
